objective: Define and executable-test a fail-closed starter reward-shop policy before any real item exists, preventing coins from authorizing purchases, basic-needs gating, unimplemented rewards or arbitrary pricing while preserving the existing ledger/API and requiring exact permission for every production shop mutation.

roles_before.artifact: The PWA projects shop.item.upserted and shop.redeemed events from the shared append-only ledger.
Existing shop.item.upsert and shop.redeem actions pass through system_apply_action and enforce item existence, active status, calibrated economy, affordability and non-repeatable redemption.
A redemption is an internal System event and never authorizes an external purchase, payment, booking, message or entitlement.
Creating, activating or redeeming a real shop item requires separate exact permission.
No current policy permits System coins to gate health, sleep, food, medication, safety, legal duties, work or education obligations.
system-quest-reward:v1 deterministically issues 0/0/1/2/4/8 coins for E/D/C/B/A/S quests; shop pricing is not yet calibrated.
Existing action names, event schemas, snapshots and the empty production shop remain valid.
The exact base SHA preserves the pre-policy shop behavior and empty production catalog.

role_dispositions.destination: No PWA projection or ledger event shape is changed in this slice.
Existing database/API actions and validation remain byte-for-byte compatible; the new policy is a controller-side preflight before a future authorized upsert.
system-shop-economy:v1 explicitly rejects cash value and external actions and permits activation only after a System-controlled fulfillment is verified.
Policy, tests and proposal artifacts create zero System events; any future shop.item.upsert/redeem remains separately permission-gated.
Executable protected-need rules reject candidates that condition sleep, rest, nutrition, medication, health care, safety or mandatory real-world duties on coins.
Starter prices are restricted to the existing C/B/A/S coin issuance ladder 1/2/4/8, with no invented conversion to TRY or cash.
No migration, production schema, existing action, event or projection changes; the production shop remains empty.
Removing the additive policy/spec/tests/controller guidance returns exactly to the base behavior.

capability_probes.assertion: Existing shop.item.upsert and shop.redeem model/PostgreSQL regression tests remain unchanged and pass.
A candidate involving cash, a purchase, subscription, booking, message, basic need or mandatory duty is rejected before any write payload can be produced.
A planned cosmetic without verified System fulfillment cannot be converted to an active shop.item.upsert payload.
Quest v2, atomic resolution, profile calibration, deadline, push, session and retired-LifeUp regressions still pass.
Base SHA 16c23888155c0bebda67faea1573f0770622f94c retains the empty uncalibrated shop and previous controller behavior.

tests.expected: Canonical planned cosmetics normalize; unsafe/external/basic-need/arbitrary-price candidates reject; only verified System fulfillment can produce an inactive-by-default candidate payload.

verification.production_schema_mutation: FORBIDDEN — no migration or DDL is part of this slice.
verification.production_player_mutation: FORBIDDEN — no shop item, redemption, reward, quest, profile or other player event may be written.
